title: Critic verdict
description: Machine-checkable structure for a critic (Opus) review verdict. Emitted as the last fenced ```json block in the critic's final message (see .claude/agents/critic.md, the final rule). Validated by a critic_verdict_check.py script wired at the deploying host's own acceptance point (rules are hardcoded there; this file is the reference schema).

verdict.description: fit = ACCEPT, fit_with_fixes = NEEDS WORK, blocker = REJECT.

blockers.description: Blocking findings. Empty when verdict is fit; non-empty when verdict is blocker.

class_completeness.description: Answer on class-wide completeness of the fix per docs/SIBLING_MAP.md (fix-the-class-not-the-instance rule).

reruns.description: Control reruns of the mechanical layer (two-layer review rule).

fixes.description: Required and non-empty when verdict is fit_with_fixes; optional otherwise.
